guidelineReference: SJA First Aid / moving and handling
title: Patient transfer from treatment centre
setting: Walking event. Patient with an injured ankle needs to be transferred via wheelchair across rough ground to hospital transport.
verdictExplanation: Alert, responsive, stable observations. Safe transfer of a stable patient using a wheelchair. Not sick: follow safe moving and handling guidelines.

shared.danger: Outdoor rough ground, rocky tracks and grass

er.disability: Cannot place weight on right foot

history.complaint: Ankle pain requires transfer to transport
history.history: Rolled their ankle whilst out country walking 30 minutes ago

followUp.question: What is the correct protocol for transferring a patient into a wheelchair?

options.text: Explain the transfer, gain consent, ensure wheelchair brakes are locked, and assist patient to stand and pivot
Lift the patient in a full-body carry without telling them
Tell the patient to jump into the wheelchair while it is moving
Move the patient without locking the wheelchair brakes to save time

followUp.explanation: Safe wheelchair transfer. Explain the procedure and gain consent. Position the wheelchair on a flat surface and lock the brakes. Assist the patient to stand and pivot, ensuring footplates are out of the way during transfer.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Explain the transfer, lock brakes, assist patient. Reassure during transfer.
levelFlags.erNotes: Ensure wheelchair is clean. Explain procedure, gain consent. Lock brakes. Assist to transfer, secure footplates and lap belt.
